headline: Binance Covers 90% of Losses Following $6.3 Billion Cyber Hack
summary: Crypto firm Binance has covered 90% of losses resulting from a $6.3 billion security breach. The FBI stated that North Korea was responsible for the hack.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges by trading volume. Digital asset platforms are frequent targets of state-sponsored cyberattacks seeking funds.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Binance absorbed 90% of customer losses following a massive hack.
